propositions: LINK events written before comparability became structural persist with stale resolver results, causing edges like epic-blocks-own-child or cousin-to-cousin to distort ready/next-batch and parent-first cascade.
A store-wide scan comparing current resolver output against recorded link pairs classifies findings as ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, or unreadable, without mutating on read-only runs.
--repair writes replacement links before unlinking stale ones, permitting resumption from superset state if interrupted, and refuses ambiguous-pair cases where relation-scoped unlink is unavailable.
Repair refuses to run while a reconciler pass is in-flight and does not hold the tracker write lock across its loop to avoid self-deadlock on the non-reentrant flock.

Live remediation of 18 edges found on the repository tracker repaired 12 (all 9 ancestor-blocking and 3 mis-escalated); the 8 residual mis-escalated edges all have closed blocked-sides and cannot affect scheduling.
